class.name: DSTex
class.brief_description: Reads and writes the DirectStorage compressed texture format.
class.description: [DSTex] creates and inspects [code].dstex[/code] files. A file stores texture dimensions, a Godot-to-RenderingDevice pixel format, mip metadata, and a GDeflate-compressed payload. The resource loader can load [code].dstex[/code] files as [Texture2D] resources automatically.

method.name: get_file_info
method.description: Returns the same header dictionary as [method read_header].

method.name: godot_format_to_rd_format
method.description: Converts an [Image] format value to the corresponding [RenderingDevice] data format value.

method.name: read_from_file
method.description: Reads a complete [code].dstex[/code] file. The result contains [code]header[/code], [code]compressed_data[/code], [code]mip_offsets[/code], and [code]mip_sizes[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary when the file is invalid or cannot be opened.

method.name: read_header
method.description: Reads only the [code].dstex[/code] header. The result contains [code]magic[/code], [code]version[/code], [code]flags[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code], [code]pixel_format[/code], [code]mip_count[/code], [code]original_size[/code], [code]compressed_size[/code], and [code]reserved[/code].

method.name: rd_format_to_godot_format
method.description: Converts a [RenderingDevice] data format value to the corresponding [Image] format value.

method.name: write_to_file
method.description: Compresses [param raw_data] with GDeflate and writes a [code].dstex[/code] file. [param format] is an [Image] format value. Returns [constant OK] on success or a Godot [Error] code on invalid data, compression failure, or file access failure.
